statement: The supported operator scale operation for the built-in sys-postgres-wire listener delegates to ServiceDefinitionsOwner, validates the desired replica count and existing PG-wire runtime configuration contract, and conditionally updates only replica_count and runtime_config for the exact active built-in native_js PostgreSQL runtime. A known applied single-row effect reports durable desired state, not achieved placement or listener reconfiguration. Typed refusal and unavailable-effect outcomes survive HTTP and harness boundaries. Both supported harnesses use this operation while retaining their actual endpoint/client checks.

constraints.statement: ServiceDefinitionsOwner and its private SystemMetadataOwnerBase row owner own validation and the existing gateway update; use one fixed built-in identity/runtime/protocol/status predicate and frozen desired values. No general service scaling API, SQL exemption, caller runtime identity, alternate scheduler or new mutable store.

Retain current CDC persistence, RuntimeServiceRebalancerOwner leadership/wake, UnifiedRebalancer policy/placement, RuntimeServiceHandler lifecycle and endpoint ownership. Existing listeners are not restarted by a config edit; configuration applies when a replica starts. No claim of listener convergence from persisted desired state or cache readback.

Scope is the exact PG-wire scale operation, its HTTP composition, the distributed node-handle operator adapter, both raw scaling harness callers and their five public-service scenario consumers, docs and bounded proof. Node checkpoint e701ca2b remains frozen. Reserved-name behavior and other raw SQL writers remain separate. No merge/publication, raised baseline, timeout extension, hook bypass or generic internal override.

Seal before production edits and retain baseline refusal/missing supported operation witness. Prove real HTTP -> owner -> gateway -> CDC -> SQLite effect, validation, identity/runtime mismatch, zero/unknown/deferred effects, retries and immutable request intent; retain existing owner wake/planner/lifecycle evidence and caller-level actual checks. Canonical runner retries zero and thermal/controller coordination; independent review before composition.
